#### Assumption 3: Identical structural distributions

We assume that all structural equations contained in the vector $\mathbf f_{*}$ are identical, and that the error terms of equivalent variables are identically distributed.

$$
\mathbf f_{*}(\mathbf{U}_*, \mathbf{Pa(*)}) = \begin{bmatrix}
f_{*}(U_{*_1}, \mathbf{Pa}(*_1))\\
f_{*}(U_{*_2}, \mathbf{Pa}(*_2))\\
... \\
f_{*}(U_{*_n}, \mathbf{Pa}(*_n))\\
\end{bmatrix}
$$
